title: Blueberry and Rosemary Mocktail
excerpt: Surprise your guests with this refined blueberry and rosemary mocktail. A refreshing, elegant drink with the perfect balance of sweet, herbal and citrus.
imageAlt: Glasses of iced blueberry and rosemary mocktail decorated with fresh sprigs and floating blueberries.
steps: In a small pot over medium heat, combine half a cup of Fresh Pick blueberries, the water, the honey and one sprig of fresh rosemary.
Cook for 5 minutes, gently pressing the blueberries with a wooden spoon so they release all their juice and aroma.
Remove from the heat, take out the rosemary sprig and let the syrup cool to room temperature for 15 minutes.
In a pitcher or cocktail shaker, mix the cold syrup, the lemon juice and the remaining whole blueberries, carefully grown in the high mountains of Guasca.
Fill two tall glasses with plenty of ice and divide the concentrated blueberry mixture between them.
Top each glass with cold sparkling water, stir slowly to blend the flavors and garnish with the remaining rosemary sprig.
tips: For a spectacular aromatic touch, pass the decorative rosemary sprig close to a flame for a few seconds right before serving.
You can make the blueberry and rosemary syrup ahead of time and store it in a sealed jar in the fridge for up to 5 days.
